exploded:
Use case: product-mockup
Asset type: engineering concept exploded rendering for indoor BLE beacon, not a manufacturing drawing.
Primary request: vertical exploded view of a round white and emerald green indoor BLE beacon puck, final assembled design roughly diameter 70 mm and thickness 20 mm. Show exactly six aligned separated layers, top to bottom: 1 white matte circular top cover with a tiny green LED light pipe; 2 thin emerald green cosmetic seam ring; 3 green circular PCB about diameter 50 mm with a small rectangular shielded BLE radio module at outer edge, a miniature push button, modest passive components, and antenna clearance area; 4 single silver CR2477 coin cell in its separate low profile battery holder beneath PCB; 5 white bottom housing with battery access; 6 flat white removable wall mounting plate with two screw slots. All parts on same central axis, mechanically plausible but explicitly concept styling. Small screws may flank the bottom housing.
Scene/backdrop: plain warm white studio, no environment.
Style/medium: high quality realistic CAD style industrial design rendering.
Composition: landscape with exploded assembly centered slightly right, generous whitespace on left for later editorial labels.
Constraints: no text, no numeric labels, no arrows, no watermarks, no dimensional callouts, no extra batteries, no display, no charging port, no sensors, no wired connectors. Keep layers visually separate and understandable.
